description: Builds source-linked Memory Library taxonomy snapshots from active facts and sessions. Defaults to a dry run so workers can inspect planned snapshots before anything is written. Only pass dry_run=false after the dry-run output is safe and the job needs live write proof.

dry_run.description: When true, preview snapshot output without writing Library docs.

max_sources.description: Maximum facts or sessions to scan.
